# UiButton

Triggers an action. A native `<button>` with variants, intents, sizes and a loading state.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | actions |
| Import | `import { UiButton } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiButton from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiButton'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/actions/UiButton.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/actions/UiButton.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `UiVariant` |  | Visual variant. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `color` | `UiColor` |  | Colour role. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `size` | `UiSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` | Native button type. Defaults to `button`, never `submit`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner and ignores activation while keeping the label, the width and keyboard focus. The button is `aria-disabled`, not `disabled`. |
| `block` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch to the width of the container. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  | Label. Stays in the accessibility tree while loading. |
| `leading` |  | Icon before the label. |
| `trailing` |  | Icon after the label. |

## Attributes

The native `<button>` (including `class`, `style`, `name`, `form`, `aria-*` and listeners).

## Keyboard

- Enter or Space activates (native).
- While `loading`, activation is ignored but the button stays focusable.

## Accessibility

- `type` defaults to `button`, so it never submits a form by accident.
- `disabled` uses the native attribute. `loading` uses `aria-disabled` + `aria-busy`, keeps the label in the accessibility tree and keeps focus.
- Hover styles apply only on devices that can hover; the focus ring uses `:focus-visible`.

## Styling

- `.vui-button`, `.vui-button__label`, `.vui-button__icon`, `.vui-button__spinner`
- `data-variant`, `data-color`, `data-size`, `data-block`, `data-loading`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/ActionsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/ActionsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-2">
  <div v-for="variant in variants" :key="variant" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
    <UiButton v-for="color in colors" :key="color" :variant="variant" :color="color">{{
      t('demo.label')
    }}</UiButton>
  </div>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
    <UiButton size="sm">{{ t('demo.add') }}</UiButton>
    <UiButton>{{ t('demo.add') }}</UiButton>
    <UiButton size="lg">{{ t('demo.add') }}</UiButton>
    <UiButton variant="outline" color="neutral">
      <template #leading><UiIcon :icon="iconPlus" /></template>
      {{ t('demo.add') }}
    </UiButton>
    <UiButton :loading="saving" data-testid="demo-save" @click="save">{{ t('demo.save') }}</UiButton>
    <UiButton disabled>{{ t('demo.disabled') }}</UiButton>
  </div>
</div>
```
